title: The transform bar keeps width and height in proportion, with the link the mock draws
goal: The mock draws a link between W and H on the transform bar, meaning a typed width brings the height along and Reset puts an animated size back to the layer own size. Today the bar W and H are independent, as they are in the panel, and the link is not drawn. Make the link work (on by default, click to unlink) and draw it as the mock does.
notes: Left from a-small-overlay-shows-transform-values-to-type-i (2026-10-13). Bar view: Sources/Photonz/TransformValueBar.swift; values land through EditorState+TransformBar.swift setTransformBarValue via LayerGeometrySelection.applying. Mock: .va-link in video-animate.html buildBar (between W and H). The mock models size as one scale percentage, which is why its W and H move together.
acceptance: The transform bar shows the link glyph between W and H, as pages/video-animate.html draws it
With the link on, a width typed into the bar changes the height in proportion, in one undo step, and the reverse
Clicking the link turns it off and on, and the state reads back to a walk
A walk at Next defaults types a width with the link on and checks both numbers
